structural_change: KVJ-A3 r2 HOST cluster child qkd_hr_core_prompt (core family, one ck_core entry): members u_control, u_hc, u_axi, u_program, u_program_rx, u_records + their glue, generated wrapper (tools/qwen_kv_die/host_cluster/gen_cluster.py). Partition results/arch/qwen_split_1014/host_root_cluster/partition_r2.json | p3 (KV-TILES-D): clock entry ck_core at the S-face centre beside the S pin-flop mass (was the SW corner: TT 545/spread 175.5); SRAMs moved to the empty NW quadrant (1024x256 at the N face band, 4x 256x64 2x2 below it) so the logic is one L band along S and E | p4 (KV-PROMPT4 10-18, coordinator review of gate p3 FAIL: pin-flop spread 114.9 TT, W/E 6.2 pins/um, SRAMs in two places + logic ring, host_rst_n 4,924 / rst_n_i 1,496 loads): (1) outline 259.2 -> 280.8 (W/E <= ~5.8 pins/um); (2) the five SRAMs in ONE abutted N-S column at the NW (x 43.2: four 256x64 at y 86.4 + k*17.856 (M4-track pitch, 36-nm abutment), the 1024x256 on top at 157.824; pins on W/E faces only, so the stack is legal with no channel), the rest of the tile one contiguous std-cell region; (3) boundary pin registers on their own balanced clock branch (bnd_branch.tcl, the dsdv_sh_vc technique, depth 6); ck_core at the S-face centre 136.8-144.0; (4) every host_rst_n consumer of the child behind a local ot_rst_relay at its rst_n pin (tools/qwen_kv_die/host_cluster/gen_prompt_rr.py; release +3 ck edges uniformly inside the child, assert immediate; members unchanged files)
